method: independent re-verification: one GET api.crossref.org/works/<doi> per DOI, performed in the STEP5K analysis session, NOT a re-read of the upstream search log's own crossref_verified flag. Title/journal/year compared after Unicode normalisation and removal of non-alphanumerics (so en-dash vs hyphen and spacing differences do not count as mismatches).
